confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking sites, with July peak-season pricing applied. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel rates are least certain and vary by neighbourhood and date. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. EUR values assume about 1.16 USD per EUR, not verified. The RBA rate comes from search-result summaries rather than an opened table, and one RBA overview page still showed 13 October, so confirm the 14 October value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against large Western European capitals with strong summer tourism demand, such as Brussels, Copenhagen and Paris, adjusted to Dutch menu and drink price levels and Amsterdam's central tourist premium.
